testCases.name: P1 Main path: the payment succeeds
testCases.description: Sandbox card succeeds. Service tasks completed by hand in Test mode until the 6.3 workers exist.

testCases.name: P2 Decline, retry, then success
testCases.description: Sandbox card declined once. The customer chooses "Try again" (the form shows 1 of 3), then the payment succeeds. Checks the decline counter, the retry loop and the confirmation path. Service tasks completed by hand in Test mode until the 6.3 workers exist.

testCases.name: P4 The customer cancels
testCases.description: Sandbox card declined. The customer chooses "Cancel the order". The run ends at "Customer cancelled" in Take payment, then releases the stock, cancels the order and tells the customer. paymentStatus is DECLINED. Service tasks completed by hand in Test mode.

testCases.name: P3 Decline limit reached
testCases.description: Sandbox card declined three times. The retry form shows 1 of 3, then 2 of 3. After the third decline the decline limit gateway (declineCount >= 3) ends Take payment at "Decline limit reached", and the order is cancelled. Service tasks completed by hand in Test mode.

testCases.name: P5 Payment service unavailable
testCases.description: Sandbox method "the payment service is unavailable". Send payment request throws PAYMENT_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE twice, with the 1-minute wait between. After the second error, Try again? takes No (unavailableCount reaches 2), Take payment ends at Service unavailable, and the order is cancelled. No refund, because no request got through. Service tasks completed by hand in Test mode.

testCases.name: P8 Commission rounding
testCases.description: Three producers with subtotals 12.35, 8.10 and 4.99 (total 25.44). The script task gives 11.73, 7.70 (7.695 rounded half up) and 4.74, and commission 1.27. The parts add up to the order total. Notify each producer runs 3 times. Service tasks completed by hand in Test mode.

testCases.name: P7 Reservation expires
testCases.description: reservationExpiresAt set 4 minutes after the start. The payment request is sent but no answer comes. At the expiry time the event sub-process "Handle reservation expiry" interrupts Take payment, compensation runs "Refund payment" for the request that was sent, and the order is cancelled. paymentStatus is RESERVATION_EXPIRED. Service tasks completed by hand in Test mode.

testCases.name: P6 No answer
testCases.description: Sandbox method "the payment service does not answer". Send payment request completes twice and no message arrives. "No answer in 5 minutes" fires twice, with the 1-minute wait between. After the second timeout Try again? takes No, Take payment ends at Service unavailable, compensation runs Refund payment once for each request sent (2 times), and the order is cancelled. Service tasks completed by hand in Test mode.
